Decides whether an event is pending from authoritative game state, not from whether the modal has rendered -- a DOM-only probe silently missed events on a no-GPU runner where a frame costs ~6s, leaving them pending so later ticks halted and the run diverged while still passing command mode. timeoutMs bumped from the default 30s to 90s (issue #586 CI): this file never buys a debris_hauler, so blast fragments/wreckage accumulate in the scene for its whole run -- deep into the file the resulting entity-heavy scene pushes real per-frame render cost past the default 30s ceiling under load, timing out `resolveEventIfPending` itself even though it correctly detects a genuinely-pending event (interaction-executor.ts's own internal 30s wait on `#bs-event-dialog .bs-event-choice`) -- a rendering-speed accommodation, not a change to what's asserted.
